info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account Instances API
Return details of the Node and all associated Instances.
Returns the Instance details based on the parameters passed.

params.name: statusId
params.description: Instance Status. “0” for Active; “1” for Inactive

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results that is returned per page. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise Nodes.
            
When no parameter is passed, all Instances within the Client or Division are returned.

info.name: Create a new instance within a new node or add a new instance to an existing node.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the created object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return created object ID.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise Nodes.
            
To get payload for creating a new instance and to get the created instance details refer InternalLink[Instance Details By Node ID Endpoint,operations-tag-Instance,operations-Instance-get_v2_instances__nodeIds_]. Pass “0” for instance ID to create a new instance.

info.name: Update properties of an existing instance based on the request body.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the updated object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the updated object ID.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise Nodes.
            
**Request:**
            
Only the property to be updated can be passed in the request body instead of the whole object. The update request body requires a total of three keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below:
* **value** – The value property provides the new value.
            
* **path** – The path property indicates the element to update. The entire path with slashes needs to be provided here. Example: /status/id

info.name: Returns the Instance status, active or inactive, based on the Instance IDs passed.

items.docs: Works on Enterprise Nodes and Customer owned Nodes.

info.name: Allows to set the status of an existing instance to Active or Inactive.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise and Customer owned Nodes.
            
To get payload for updating an Instance Status refer InternalLink[Instance Status Endpoint,operations-tag-Instance,operations-Instance-get_v2_instances_status__instanceIds_]. Status ID values – “0” for Active; “1” for Inactive. There can be multiple instances in the payload for which the status update is intended.

info.name: Returns the instance hardware usage based on the Node ID.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise Nodes.
            
The maximum time range allowed is 7 days over the period of last 365 days.
